name: incandescent-reliquary-recollection-least-influence-draw
notes: Incandescent Reliquary (wsycqp2l90, Custom/GameLogic.php RecollectionPhase() ~9852-9862): "At the beginning of your recollection phase, if you are the player with the least influence, draw a card." Seeded directly onto the field (this check lives in the plain per-turn RecollectionPhase() switch, not a materialized Enter macro, so a raw zone-seed is a faithful vehicle for it). Both players have equal influence (7 cards in hand each, matching real GA rules where a tie counts as "least"), so GetInfluence($turnPlayer) <= GetInfluence($otherPlayer) is true. Reached player 1's own turn-2 recollection phase using the established 3-action shortcut (P1 ends turn 1, P2 ends their turn, P1 declines the material-phase level-up offer). Verified live: the card's TurnEffects gains "wsycqp2l90_DRAW_ANIM" (the same marker the real Draw() call is paired with) and the deck count drops by an extra card beyond the normal turn-draw. Break/restore verified: commenting out the Draw()/AddTurnEffect() calls makes the fixture fail and restoring it passes again.

rulesClauses: At the beginning of your recollection phase, if you are the player with the least influence, draw a card.
